findings.fix: Lift it to a top-level private lemma generic in `σ` and an arbitrary `MvPowerSeries.HasEval a` family, then let all four proofs be `rw [series-level identity]` (`subst_invPair_formalAdd`, `subst_unitR_formalAdd`, `subst_unitL_formalAdd`, `formalAdd_assoc`) followed by an application of it.
findings.issue: `hstep` is the general transport `eval₂ id a (subst (pair q₁ q₂) formalAdd) = formalAddEval (eval₂ id a q₁) (eval₂ id a q₂)`, but is a local `have` hard-wired to `σ = Unit ⊕ Unit ⊕ Unit`, so the three existing copies of the identical argument at `σ = Unit` cannot use it: `formalAddEval_formalInverseEval` (313-331), `formalAddEval_zero_right` (425-444), `formalAddEval_zero_left` (450-469).

summary: The new closure lemma is proved by an argument that is entirely generic in the series but is stated only for `formalAdd`, while the identical fact for `formalThirdRoot`/`formalInverse` is still carried as hypotheses on neighbouring lemmas; and the generic transport step is buried in a local `have` fixed to one variable type, duplicating three sibling proofs in the same file.
